# Wayly

> Aged care software built for Australian families, not providers. Wayly helps families understand and check Support at Home statements, invoices, fees and contributions in plain English.

## Tools
- [Statement Decoder](https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/statement-decoder): check a Support at Home statement line by line
- [Invoice Checker](https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/invoice-checker): check an aged care contribution invoice
- [Contribution Estimator](https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/contribution-estimator): estimate Support at Home contributions
- [Budget Calculator](https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/budget-calculator): plan a Support at Home quarterly budget
- [Classification Self-Check](https://wayly.com.au/ai-tools/classification-self-check): see which classification is likely

## Levels and policy
- [Support at Home levels](https://wayly.com.au/support-at-home-levels): all 8 classification budgets (from 01/10/2026)
- [CHSP extended to 2029](https://wayly.com.au/chsp/extension-2029): CHSP stays standalone to 30 June 2029

## Templates
- [Aged care letter templates and checklists](https://wayly.com.au/resources/templates): 20 copy-ready letters and checklists
